name: @pipeworx/mcp-riot-games

tools.name: account_by_puuid
tools.description: Look up a Riot account (game_name, tag_line, puuid) by puuid via the regional Riot Account API (americas | europe | asia).

tools.name: summoner_by_puuid
tools.description: Fetch LoL summoner details (summoner ID, account ID, summonerLevel, profileIconId, revisionDate) for a puuid on a specific platform (e.g. na1, euw1).

tools.name: match_ids_by_puuid
tools.description: List recent LoL match IDs for a puuid on a regional cluster; filter by queue type, start/end timestamp, and paginate with start + count.

tools.name: match
tools.description: Fetch full LoL match detail by match ID (e.g. NA1_123): participants, champions, stats, team outcomes, and game metadata.

tools.name: match_timeline
tools.description: Fetch per-frame event timeline for a LoL match ID — kills, item purchases, level-ups, building destructions at each minute interval.

tools.name: league_entries
tools.description: List all LoL ranked ladder entries for a queue (RANKED_SOLO_5x5), tier (DIAMOND), and division (I) on a platform; paginates with page parameter.

tools.name: champion_mastery
tools.description: Return full champion mastery list for a puuid on a platform: mastery level, points, chest granted, tokens earned for every champion.

tools.name: summoner_top_mastery
tools.description: Highest champion mastery entries for one League of Legends account from the Riot Games API, given a puuid and a platform routing value such as na1, euw1, or kr, with count controlling how many champions come back (default 3). Returns championId, championLevel, championPoints, last play time, and chest and token flags for those champions. Answers which champions a League of Legends player has played most and mastered furthest.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-riot-games forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the riot-games pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
